failure_definition: SpO2 sensor drift at low perfusion, characterized by a deviation in SpO2 measurements from the true value under conditions of reduced blood flow.
causal_mechanism: The multi-wavelength PPG sensor's reliance on pulsatile blood volume changes, which weaken under low perfusion, degrading the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).
current_device_behavior: The smartwatch health monitor uses a multi-wavelength PPG sensor to estimate SpO2 levels.
failure_point: The failure occurs when the device is unable to accurately measure SpO2 levels under low perfusion conditions, specifically when the perfusion index (PI) falls below a certain threshold.
blocking_constraint: The need to maintain a compact and power-efficient design, which limits the integration of additional sensors or complex signal processing algorithms, blocks the obvious solution of simply replacing the existing PPG sensor with a more robust low-perfusion-optimized sensor.
